Caldera Surge.name: Caldera Surge
Caldera Surge.description: The user's signature move: both palms drive heat and shaping into the street at once, melting a lane of stone into a wave of slag that surges forward and quenches solid. Enemies in its path take massive fire and bludgeoning damage and are locked to the knees in cooled rock; held back, it cools before contact and only pins them. Afterward the user cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
